text:
Priya Singh: Heads-up: Newton Labs dropped off 4 alpha blades. Ops wants scope for telemetry + firmware rollback windows before we run any stress. also they asked about announcement embargo.
Evan Brooks: Nice. do we have a carrier/serial mapping? and any known bad-ssh keys to wipe?
Priya Singh: carrier mapping in drive: https://rwd.team/newton-alpha-gear (internal). No keys flagged yet.
Carlos Mendes: From bench side: plan is 2x calibration sweeps (10m each), then 2x 45m steady runs, and one forced-failure power-cycle test. Need to confirm we can trigger clean rollback to fw 1.2.0 if 1.3 regresses.
Dana Park: infra note: we'll enable presigned uploads and a verification lambda. prefer multipart/form-data POST so lab can stream logs without buffering. example curl for POST:
```bash
curl -F "file=@./session.tgz" "${PRESIGNED_POST_URL}"
```
Priya Singh: Newton legal asked for an embargo: no public mention until both parties sign press copy and agree on a date. propose slack lock until 2025-09-01.
Maya Chen: Legal needs the signed NDA + data processing addendum before we accept any PII or raw logs. requested retention = 120 days for alpha data. partner okay with 120d.
Carlos Mendes: telemetry we need: per-GPU power (1s), core temp (5s), fan rpm, host power rails, and per-request latency. also we should capture kernel oops logs and watchdog timestamps.
Evan Brooks: can we gate the marketplace listing if this becomes a preview offering? Ops wants a checklist to ensure SLA claims are accurate.
Priya Singh: marketing asked for a draft co-branded blurb; not publishing until engineering thumbs-up. i'll coordinate with product.
Dana Park: benchbot, please reserve an alpha window and tag it NEWTON-ALPHA-EX. Also create an artifact bucket with lifecycle 120d.
benchbot: Reserved: queue 7621, window 2025-08-22 01:30-05:30 UTC. Bucket created: s3://rwd-newton-alpha-7621 (retention 120d). :white_check_mark:
Carlos Mendes: good. also we should version prompts and seeds. add a small smoke model (gpt-compat-500M) + one realistic LLM trace with 1k/2k token mixes.
Priya Singh: Newton asked if we can share aggregate perf numbers (no raw logs) under NDA for partner investors. legal ok with aggregates only. Maya, confirm acceptable aggregation rollup?
Maya Chen: Aggregates allowed if we remove unit ids and any sample text. include a clause: no verbatim prompt leakage. I will add to the DPA.
Dana Park: upload flow: lab will POST session.tgz to presigned POST, then webhook will verify checksum and tag artifact with metadata: {"session_id":"<uuid>","fw":"1.3.0","host":"blade-03"}. please note schema change below.
Priya Singh: attaching Newton telemetry schema in drive. also they prefer we run a power-rail undervoltage test to validate graceful degradation.
Carlos Mendes: agree. test matrix:
- calibration sweep x2
- steady-state 45m x2 (1k and 2k contexts)
- long-tail stress 20m (continuous generations)
- forced rollback to 1.2.0 and re-run quick smoke
- power-cycle failure simulation
Make sure lab techs have rollback steps documented.
Dana Park: i'll push a small README to the drive with the POST sample and webhook verification steps.
Priya Singh: action items: 1) Maya to finalize NDA/DPA (ETA EOD) 2) Dana to deploy presigned POST + webhook (ETA 48h) 3) Carlos to publish run matrix + smoke configs (ETA EOD+1) 4) Evan to align product/marketing embargo plan (ETA EOD).
Evan Brooks: i'll sync marketing and propose a tentative co-announcement date (not before 2025-09-01).
Maya Chen: pinged Newton legal now.
Carlos Mendes: i'll drop the smoke configs into the drive and include seed values.
Priya Singh: thanks all. i'll post a final checklist here once NDA signed. :thumbsup:
